subject: Reserved pool throughput addendum & renewal coordination — ApexHealth
messages:
From: Jordan Miles <jmiles@apexhealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal / capacity bump question for reserved pool

Hi Soojin,

We’re starting the renewal conversations for our Redwood Dedicated contract (renewal due 2026-04-15). Traffic forecasts show a 35% increase in peak token throughput over the next 12 months. We’d like to discuss adding 2x additional GPUs to our reserved pool and getting explicit throughput guarantees (tokens/sec) for the renewed term.

Primary asks:
- Add 2 A100-class GPUs to our reserved capacity starting on renewal date.
- Include a throughput SLO in the renewal addendum (tokens/sec at p95 and p99) and a short remediation path if we fall below targets.
- Clarify activation/billing timing for the additional GPUs — do they start on contract signature or on the renewal effective date?

Can your team draft the language or provide recommended SLO numbers we should expect for our current model mix (mixed LLM traffic: chat + embeddings + reranking)? Procurement will need a draft addendum to route for signatures.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Miles
Director of Platform Engineering
ApexHealth

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Miles <jmiles@apexhealth.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal / capacity bump question for reserved pool

Jordan — thanks for the heads up and the clear asks. Happy to take this forward. Quick summary of next steps from our side:

1) SE team to validate expected p95/p99 tokens/sec given your model mix and the two additional A100s (Connor).
2) Draft contractual addendum that:
   - Specifies reserved pool sizing (current + 2x A100) and activation date,
   - Includes throughput SLOs (p95/p99 tokens/sec) with measurement windows and error budget language,
   - Outlines remediation (crediting and capacity remediation timeline) and a technical escalation process.
3) Confirm billing/proration approach (billing team).

Connor — can you run a throughput estimate matrix and recommend p95/p99 numbers we should formalize in the addendum? I’ll prepare a draft addendum and send for Apex procurement review once we have the numbers.

Jordan — would Apex prefer the addendum to state that additional GPUs are effective on signature or to activate on the renewal effective date? We can support either; just want to align billing.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Jordan Miles <jmiles@apexhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Mar 2026 08:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal / capacity bump question for reserved pool

Hi all — ran a quick calc based on ApexHealth’s telemetry (apex-telemetry Q4/2025) and the proposed +2 A100s. Key assumptions: 50% chat tokens (avg seq len 450), 30% embeddings (short seq), 20% reranking (burstier). Burst reservation: we conservatively size for 95th-percentile peak concurrency.

Prelim recommended SLOs for contractual language (per reserved pool):
- p95: 14,500 tokens/sec sustained over a 5-minute window
- p99: 18,800 tokens/sec sustained over a 1-minute window

Measurement notes:
- Metrics measured at the pool egress (token emission rate aggregated across GPUs).
- P95 computed on 5-minute rolling windows sampled at 10s resolution; p99 on 1-minute windows sampled at 5s resolution.

Remediation proposal:
1) If measured p95 falls below 90% of target for two consecutive business days -> initiate capacity remediation (hotfix scaling or workload routing) within 24 hours, and apply service credit of 5% of that month’s reserved capacity fee for the impacted pool.
2) If p99 falls below 85% of target for three business days -> escalation to on-call infra + 10% credit for impacted month unless remediation completes within 72 hours.

I’m attaching a throughput_calc_sheet.xlsx with scenario buckets (low/expected/high) and the raw math. Also included notes on quantization/kv-cache tuning that can often raise effective tokens/sec without adding GPUs.

Attachment: throughput_calc_sheet.xlsx (xlsx)

Happy to walk through these numbers with Apex’s infra team — Connor
Connor O’Brien
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.com

From: Jordan Miles <jmiles@apexhealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@apexhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal / capacity bump question for reserved pool

Thanks Connor — that level of detail is perfect. Procurement wants the addendum to contain:
- The p95/p99 numbers you recommended, explicitly called out with measurement windows.
- A clear definition of "impacted month" for credit calculations.
- Language clarifying whether credits are the sole remedy or if we can force a performance remediation (we prefer a guaranteed remediation timeline in addition to credits).

Two quick clarifications: can you add a short bullet that says the throughput measurement excludes background maintenance windows and scheduled cluster upgrades? Procurement typically flags that. Also confirm that the credits would prorate only against the reserved pool fee (not our usage overages).

We’re fine with the additional GPUs becoming effective on signature — procurement will route the addendum for an accelerated approval if the billing date aligns with signature. Please send the draft addendum + DocuSign link.

Jordan

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Miles <jmiles@apexhealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@apexhealth.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 15:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Draft addendum + next steps (ApexHealth renewal)

Jordan / Procurement — attaching the initial addendum draft that incorporates Connor’s recommended p95/p99 numbers and the remediation language you requested. Highlights:

- Reserved pool change: +2x A100 GPUs; sizing table included and effective on signature (per your preference).
- Throughput SLOs: p95 14,500 tokens/sec (5-min window), p99 18,800 tokens/sec (1-min window).
- Measurement exclusions: scheduled maintenance and pre-announced cluster upgrades are excluded from SLO calculations.
- Remedies: credits scoped to reserved pool fee with defined "impacted month" = calendar month in which the deficiency occurs. Additionally, we commit to remediation timelines: initial mitigation within 24 hours, full remediation plan within 72 hours, or an escalated engineering response.

Attachments: APX_Addendum_Draft_v1.pdf (pdf); throughput_calc_sheet.xlsx (xlsx)

Next steps:
1) Please review the attached PDF and provide any redlines by EOB Mar 20.
2) Once redlines are minimal, we will upload to DocuSign and confirm activation date on signature.

I’ll also open a HubSpot ticket and attach the sheet. HubSpot link: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567

Thanks — happy to hop on a 30-minute call if Apex infra wants to walk the measurement logic.

Best,
Soojin Lee
